content: SMB restaurant/retail order management systems (Toast, Chowbus-style OMS) centralize orders from all channels (website, delivery apps, dine-in, phone) and route to kitchen display/printer by order type. Common status state machine: Placed -> Accepted -> In Preparation -> Ready -> Completed, branching by fulfillment type: Pickup (ready-for-pickup -> picked-up), Dine-in (table-assigned -> served -> paid/closed), Delivery (driver-requested -> en-route-to-restaurant -> picked-up-by-driver -> dropping-off -> delivered). Each fulfillment type shares the core prep pipeline but has a distinct terminal handoff leg; systems track this via an order 'fulfillment_type' + separate 'fulfillment_status' alongside the shared 'kitchen_status'.
